title: One control set, three frameworks
intro: How I build AI governance programmes: design each control once, then map it to every framework it satisfies, so one piece of evidence serves several audits.

rows.detail: Identify, rate and treat AI risks across the lifecycle
Quality, provenance and bias checks on training data
System design, purpose and limitations on record
Automatic, traceable logs of system behaviour
Named people who can monitor, override and stop
Testing, red-teaming and resilience to attack
Effects on people and fundamental rights
Track performance and drift in production
Report serious incidents, fix root causes

footer: Build each control once. Map it everywhere.
note: Indicative mapping for illustration; always confirm against the official texts.
